topic.topicDisplayName: Induction therapy in AAV: rituximab vs cyclophosphamide, RITUXVAS, RAVE trials
topic.coverageNote: The RAVE trial full text is in PMC and reports the noninferiority comparison of rituximab and cyclophosphamide for remission induction. RITUXVAS (PMID 20647198) is not in PMC, so its results are not used.

mcqs.question: What regimens did RAVE compare for remission induction?

options.A: Rituximab 375 mg/m2 weekly for 4 weeks versus cyclophosphamide 2 mg/kg/day
options.C: Azathioprine versus methotrexate for maintenance only
options.D: Rituximab 1 g every 6 months versus placebo without cyclophosphamide

mcqs.explanation: RAVE compared rituximab 375 mg per square meter weekly for 4 weeks with cyclophosphamide 2 mg per kilogram per day.

sourceRefs.excerpt: rituximab (375 mg per square meter of body-surface area per week for 4 weeks) as compared with cyclophosphamide (2 mg per kilogram of body weight per day)

mcqs.question: What was the primary end point?
mcqs.explanation: Glucocorticoids were tapered, and the primary end point was remission of disease without prednisone at 6 months.

sourceRefs.excerpt: the primary end point was remission of disease without the use of prednisone at 6 months.

mcqs.question: What proportion of each group reached the primary end point, and what did that show?

options.A: 64% with rituximab and 53% with control, meeting noninferiority
options.D: The trial stopped before an end point

mcqs.explanation: Sixty-three patients in the rituximab group (64%) and 52 in the control group (53%) reached the primary end point, meeting noninferiority (P<0.001).

sourceRefs.excerpt: Sixty-three patients in the rituximab group (64%) reached the primary end point, as compared with 52 patients in the control group (53%), a result that met the criterion for noninferiority (P<0.001).

mcqs.question: In which subgroup was the rituximab-based regimen more efficacious than cyclophosphamide?

options.C: Patients treated without glucocorticoids from day 1
options.D: The paper found no subgroup difference of this kind

mcqs.explanation: The trial report says the rituximab-based regimen was more efficacious than the cyclophosphamide-based regimen for inducing remission of relapsing disease.

sourceRefs.excerpt: The rituximab-based regimen was more efficacious than the cyclophosphamide-based regimen for inducing remission of relapsing

mcqs.question: Who was enrolled?

options.A: 197 ANCA-positive patients with Wegener granulomatosis or microscopic polyangiitis

mcqs.explanation: Nine centres enrolled 197 ANCA-positive patients with either Wegener granulomatosis or microscopic polyangiitis.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Nine centers enrolled 197 ANCA-positive patients with either Wegener’s granulomatosis or microscopic polyangiitis.
